data.name: Blova
data.detailed_description:
The bots need Stardust—and you are their best hope.

Guide blocks through your sector, rotate them into position and trigger Blovas: Stardust is released and new chain reactions become possible. Begin your hunt for Stardust now!

PLAY SOLO, LOCALLY OR ONLINE

• Solo: Collect Stardust and improve your global cross-platform high score.

• Local Multiplayer: Up to four players each control a sector with their own controller.

• Online Multiplayer: Play with friends and guild members.

• Quick Online Match: Automatically find three other players of similar skill.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY

Solo, Cooperative, Stardust Race, Countdown, Last Bot Flying and Blova Odyssey offer different objectives.

YOUR BOT, YOUR STYLE

Earn Stardust to unlock and combine bots, skins, block designs, backgrounds, frames and Blova effects. Cosmetics never affect gameplay balance. Blova is family-friendly and guaranteed free from pay-to-win.

MORE FEATURES

• 1–4 players

• Full controller support

• Mouse and keyboard controls

• Online matchmaking and cross-platform Blova accounts

• Global Top 100 leaderboards

• Friends, guilds and social features

• English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Chinese and Japanese

• Prepared for Windows, macOS, Linux and Steam Deck

More content will follow depending on Blova’s success.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or AMD Radeon R7 260X; OpenGL 3.3 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: 1280 × 720 display. Broadband internet required for online features. Local multiplayer requires one compatible controller per player.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 or later
  • Processor: 64-bit Intel Core i3 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus, Apple M1 GPU or equivalent; OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: 1280 × 720 display. Broadband internet required for online features. Local multiplayer requires one compatible controller per player.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux distribution released in 2020 or later (Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or AMD Radeon R7 260X; OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio, PipeWire or compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: 1280 × 720 display. X11 or Wayland. Broadband internet required for online features. Local multiplayer requires one compatible controller per player.
